name: Alpaca Market Data API — real-time stock stream (market data only)
access: Websocket wss://stream.data.alpaca.markets/v2/{iex|sip|delayed_sip}; API key id and secret from <UNKNOWN_HOME>/secrets/alpaca.json (outside git)
cost_model: Basic plan: no charge stated for IEX real-time data; Algo Trader Plus (all US exchanges, unlimited websocket symbols) is a paid plan. Price not recorded here; never enabled without the owner's choice.
budget: none required for the Basic (IEX) feed

rate_limit.source: No message rate is documented for the stream. Self-imposed: at most one connection attempt per second (back-off 1 s to 30 s). Documented limits: Basic 'Websocket subscriptions: 30 symbols' (about-market-data-api, enforced as the bus line budget) and error 406 'connection limit exceeded', 1 connection for many subscriptions (streaming-market-data).

failure_behavior: Disconnect: every key shows STALE and the adapter reconnects with exponential back-off (1 s to 30 s). 405 symbol limit: LINE_BUDGET for the keys of that request; 409/410: NOT_ENTITLED, and the bus fails the key over to the next configured source.

datasets.description: US stock and ETF quotes (bid/ask with sizes in round lots) and trades (price, size, exchange, conditions) with RFC-3339 nanosecond timestamps
datasets.coverage: US stocks and ETFs. Basic plan: IEX only (a single venue, not a consolidated quote). Algo Trader Plus: all US exchanges (SIP).
datasets.history_depth: Live stream; the tick store keeps the owner's received trades for its configured retention (default 3 days)
datasets.availability_rule: Live: available at receipt time (ts_recv_ns); ts_source_ns is the message timestamp t
datasets.rights_source: Alpaca disclosures list a 'NYSE Market Data Display Services Agreement' (https://files.alpaca.markets/disclosures/library/NYSE+Market+Data+Display+Services+Agreement.pdf), a 'NASDAQ OMX Global Subscriber Agreement' (https://files.alpaca.markets/disclosures/library/NASDAQ+OMX+Global+Subscriber+Agreement.pdf) and Alpaca Terms & Conditions (https://files.alpaca.markets/disclosures/library/TermsAndConditions.pdf). Their texts were not read for this record: display to the account owner only; no redistribution, no non-display use and no cloud-model processing until the owner reviews them.
datasets.rights_status: unreviewed: display to the owner only
